description: End-to-end RH upload support for the third document type, Adiantamento do 13º Salário (ADIANTAMENTO_13): detection, extraction (reusing the monthly parser), controller routing, atomic persistence, the schema check-constraint change + Drizzle migration, a DEDICATED 13º-advance email notification (new mail method + template), and a dedicated extraction spec. Monthly-payroll and férias behavior must remain byte-for-byte unchanged. This feature is self-contained in the RH module + schema + mail service and does not depend on FEAT-002.
steps: Parser (src/common/pdf-extraction-rh.ts): refactor extractDadosFolhaPagamento so its full body becomes a private function extractDadosFolhaComMarcador(text: string, marcador: string). Make extractDadosFolhaPagamento(text) a thin wrapper calling it with 'FOLHA DE PAGAMENTO'. Replace the hard-coded 'FOLHA DE PAGAMENTO' literals used for validation AND inside pageHeaderPattern with the passed marcador (escape it for regex). Export a new isAdiantamento13(text: string): boolean returning text.includes('FOLHA DE ADIANTAMENTO DE 13º'), and extractDadosAdiantamento13(text) as a wrapper calling extractDadosFolhaComMarcador(text, 'FOLHA DE ADIANTAMENTO DE 13º'). Do not alter any field returned on the monthly path.

Spec (src/rh/rh-adiantamento13-extraction.spec.ts): follow the embedded-string-fixture style of src/rh/rh-extraction.spec.ts. To obtain fixture text, write a throwaway Node script that imports unpdf and runs extractText(new Uint8Array(fs.readFileSync('13 SAL.pdf')), { mergePages: true }) (and the same for 'FOLHA 13 SALARIO.pdf'), print the text, paste it verbatim into the spec as a template-literal fixture, then DELETE the script. Assert: isAdiantamento13 returns true for the 13º fixture and false for a 'FOLHA DE PAGAMENTO' string and a 'RECIBO DE FÉRIAS' string; extractDadosAdiantamento13 returns cnpj '13.744.722/0001-00', funcionarios length 4, and the employee 'ALDENORA VITORIA DE CARVALHO' with salarioLiquido close to 862,03. Optionally add the 12-employee 07.754.759/0001-09 fixture asserting totals (Total Líquido 10.614,98, Total FGTS 849,17).

Controller (src/rh/rh-upload.controller.ts): extend RhFileResult.tipo union to 'FOLHA_MENSAL' | 'FERIAS' | 'ADIANTAMENTO_13'; import isAdiantamento13 and extractDadosAdiantamento13 from ../common/pdf-extraction-rh. In processFile(), after the existing `if (isReciboFerias(text)) return this.processFeriasFile(...)` add `if (isAdiantamento13(text)) return this.processAdiantamento13File(file, text, ctx);` BEFORE the processFolhaFile fallback. Add private processAdiantamento13File modeled on processFolhaFile: parse via extractDadosAdiantamento13; findClientForUpload by cnpj digits; call rhService.checkDuplicateAdiantamento13(client.id, dados.competencia); upload to R2 key `rh/${cnpjDigits}/${year}/${month}/adiantamento13-${crypto.randomUUID()}.pdf`; call rhService.processarAdiantamento13(...); on failure delete the R2 key; set tipo:'ADIANTAMENTO_13' on every returned RhFileResult; send email via the NEW mail.sendAdiantamento13NotificationEmail (see the mail step below) passing { to: client.emails, clientName: client.razaoSocial, competencia: dados.competencia, totalFuncionarios: dados.totalFuncionarios, totalLiquido: String(dados.totalLiquido) }, skip when client.suspenso or no emails, fire-and-forget with the same catch+logger pattern as processFolhaFile.

Mail (src/mail/mail.service.ts): add a NEW public method sendAdiantamento13NotificationEmail({ to, clientName, competencia, totalFuncionarios, totalLiquido }) and a private buildAdiantamento13Html, both modeled closely on the existing sendFolhaPagamentoNotificationEmail / buildFolhaPagamentoHtml (13º advance is multi-employee like monthly payroll). Use the apiToken guard + recipients mapping + this.sendEmail(payload, 'adiantamento13_notification') pattern. Subject: `Adiantamento do 13º Salário disponível · Competência ${competencia}`; text+html body reference 'Adiantamento do 13º Salário', total de funcionários, and total líquido (via this.formatCurrency), and reuse this.layout.wrap, the 'Kontabb · Contabilidade Borges' footer, the 'Nunca enviamos documentos em anexo por e-mail' notice, and the `${this.portalUrl}/cliente` link exactly like the existing templates. Leave sendFeriasNotificationEmail and sendFolhaPagamentoNotificationEmail untouched.

Service (src/rh/rh.service.ts): add processarAdiantamento13(input) modeled exactly on processarFolhaPagamento — same employee-count consistency check, same single-SQL-CTE atomic insert of folha + funcionarios_rh upsert + itens_folha_pagamento + eventos_auditoria — but insert tipo 'ADIANTAMENTO_13' and use audit acao 'ADIANTAMENTO_13_UPLOADADO' (entidade_tipo 'FOLHA_PAGAMENTO'). Add checkDuplicateAdiantamento13(clienteId, competencia) mirroring checkDuplicateFolha but with eq(folhasPagamento.tipo, 'ADIANTAMENTO_13').

Schema (src/database/schema.ts): change the chk_folhas_tipo check (around line 498) to sql`${table.tipo} IN ('FOLHA_MENSAL', 'FERIAS', 'ADIANTAMENTO_13')`. Leave uidx_folhas_cliente_competencia partial index (WHERE tipo = 'FOLHA_MENSAL') unchanged so a monthly folha and a 13º advance can share a competência.

Migration: create drizzle/0032_<name>.sql that drops and recreates chk_folhas_tipo with the new allowed set, matching the SQL style of drizzle/0010_adicionar_ferias_rh.sql (use ALTER TABLE "folhas_pagamento" DROP CONSTRAINT "chk_folhas_tipo"; --> statement-breakpoint then ALTER TABLE ... ADD CONSTRAINT "chk_folhas_tipo" CHECK ("folhas_pagamento"."tipo" IN ('FOLHA_MENSAL', 'FERIAS', 'ADIANTAMENTO_13'));). Add drizzle/meta/0032_snapshot.json (copy 0031_snapshot.json, give it a fresh top-level id, set prevId to 0031's id, and update chk_folhas_tipo.value to the 3-value IN list) and append an idx:32 entry to drizzle/meta/_journal.json with tag '0032_<name>'. Preferred alternative: run `npm run db:generate` to emit all three consistently from the edited schema.
acceptance_criteria: `npx jest src/rh/rh-adiantamento13-extraction.spec.ts` passes all new assertions (detector true/false cases; CNPJ 13.744.722/0001-00; 4 funcionários; ALDENORA líquido 862,03).
`npx jest src/rh/rh-extraction.spec.ts src/rh/rh-ferias-extraction.spec.ts` still pass unchanged (monthly + férias regression guard).
`npm run build` compiles with no type errors (RhFileResult union extended; new controller/service methods typecheck).
`npm run db:check` reports drizzle state consistent with no pending drift after the schema + migration + snapshot/journal changes.

A dedicated sendAdiantamento13NotificationEmail method exists in mail.service.ts (not a reuse of sendFolhaPagamentoNotificationEmail) with a 'Adiantamento do 13º Salário'-specific subject, and processAdiantamento13File wires it as fire-and-forget skipping suspended clients. sendFeriasNotificationEmail is left intact.
No throwaway fixture-extraction script remains in the repo.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED. Discriminator value is 'ADIANTAMENTO_13' everywhere.

Parser (src/common/pdf-extraction-rh.ts): the former body of extractDadosFolhaPagamento is now the private function extractDadosFolhaComMarcador(text, marcador). New exported symbols: isAdiantamento13(text): boolean (returns text.includes('FOLHA DE ADIANTAMENTO DE 13º')) and extractDadosAdiantamento13(text): DadosFolhaPagamento | null (wrapper -> marcador 'FOLHA DE ADIANTAMENTO DE 13º'). extractDadosFolhaPagamento is now a thin wrapper -> marcador 'FOLHA DE PAGAMENTO'. Generalization: added a module-level helper escapeRegExp(str) and the pageHeaderPattern is now built via `new RegExp(...)` interpolating escapeRegExp(marcador) in place of the hard-coded 'FOLHA DE PAGAMENTO' literal. Monthly + férias extraction specs unchanged and still green. extractDadosAdiantamento13 returns the same DadosFolhaPagamento shape (reuse it in FEAT-002 if needed).

Controller (src/rh/rh-upload.controller.ts): RhFileResult.tipo union is now 'FOLHA_MENSAL' | 'FERIAS' | 'ADIANTAMENTO_13'. processFile routing order: isReciboFerias -> isAdiantamento13 -> processFolhaFile fallback. New private method processAdiantamento13File. R2 key format: `rh/${cnpjDigits}/${year}/${month}/adiantamento13-${crypto.randomUUID()}.pdf`.

Service (src/rh/rh.service.ts): new processarAdiantamento13(input) (tipo 'ADIANTAMENTO_13', audit acao 'ADIANTAMENTO_13_UPLOADADO', entidade_tipo 'FOLHA_PAGAMENTO', duplicate code 'ADIANTAMENTO_13_DUPLICADO') and new checkDuplicateAdiantamento13(clienteId, competencia) (filters tipo = 'ADIANTAMENTO_13'). Input type is DadosFolhaPagamento.

Mail (src/mail/mail.service.ts): NEW dedicated sendAdiantamento13NotificationEmail({ to, clientName, competencia, totalFuncionarios, totalLiquido }) + private buildAdiantamento13Html, modeled on the monthly-payroll pair. Subject 'Adiantamento do 13º Salário disponível · Competência ${competencia}'. sendEmail operation tag 'adiantamento13_notification'. sendFolhaPagamentoNotificationEmail and sendFeriasNotificationEmail left intact.

Schema (src/database/schema.ts): chk_folhas_tipo now IN ('FOLHA_MENSAL', 'FERIAS', 'ADIANTAMENTO_13'). Partial unique index uidx_folhas_cliente_competencia still WHERE tipo = 'FOLHA_MENSAL' (unchanged), so a monthly folha and a 13º advance can share a competência.

Migration: generated via `npm run db:generate` (preferred path). File name chosen: drizzle/0032_adicionar_adiantamento13.sql. Also emitted drizzle/meta/0032_snapshot.json (id 36a65b26-5566-4ca8-b79c-30e446c88db9, prevId 8de37f4c-ea22-47d1-b390-4df0470c4ddd = 0031's id) and journal entry idx 32 tag '0032_adicionar_adiantamento13'. `npm run db:check` reports no drift. db:migrate NOT run (live DB).

Spec: src/rh/rh-adiantamento13-extraction.spec.ts with embedded verbatim fixtures from both reference PDFs (CNPJ 13.744.722/0001-00 = 4 funcionários; CNPJ 07.754.759/0001-09 = 12 funcionários, Total Líquido 10.614,98, Total FGTS 849,17). Throwaway extraction script deleted.

Verification: all three verification commands pass (25 extraction tests green, nest build clean, drizzle check clean).
